text_block_list.text: After our outing, she said there was a place she wanted me to come with her to, and we arrived at—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ta-daaa♡
It's that observation deck everyone's super hyped about~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Aaaand, here are today's teachers♡

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Aha, I'm Teacher Number One
for Vivlos-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I am Teacher Number Two.
Good day.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Both of their socials are super amazing!
They go totally viral, and they have so many followers!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Always right at the center of trends! That feels sooo celebrity-like♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: So that's why I asked a teacher! Like, "Please give me a lecture on taking photogenic pictures!" ♡

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, leave it to me♪
I'll teach you the secret to going viral♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: First of all, naturally~, with a cute pose!♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it really is so cute!! Me too, me too~!
Trainy, take a picture of me, take one~♡
(*Click, click, click—*)
choice_data_list: (...I managed to take a super cute photo!)

text_block_list.text: Inside the arcade adjoining the observation deck—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Secret Technique: Mascot Swarm Jutsu. Now then,
which one is the real Machan, I wonder~?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, what's that, so cute~♡
Then I'll also—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Which one is the real one, I wondeeerr?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Impressive, nicely done!
Aiming for the sister-fandom angle is quite shrewd of you.
(*Click, click—*)
choice_data_list: (The fans would absolutely love this photo!)
(The fans would absolutely love this photo!)

text_block_list.text: Inside the shopping mall adjoining the observation deck—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's that ice cream that's super viral on social media!
You know, the one where everyone does the speed-eating challenge!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Trainie, take a video of this!
Come on, ready, here I go~?!

After that, I continued taking photos of things
likely to generate buzz and posting them—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's already trending near the top!
It's all thanks to Curren-san and the others!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'm glad I could help♪

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Muhu, Machan's article is trending too.
I'm so deeply grateful to be here with you.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I'm so happy... ♡
Thank you both so much ♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Look, Trainy, take a look!
Everyone's comments—

"That sounds so fun!"
"I want to go too!"

"You're way too good at the crane game!"
"Maybe I'll give it a try on my next day off!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Everyone looks up to me...
Just like I did back then...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "You know, when I first went to Dubai, I was totally captivated too!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Everything's so sparkly, everything's so wonderful!
I de-finitely want to live here! ...is what I thought!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
If it's for that, I felt like I could do my absolute best,
that I could do anything... ♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want to become a celebrity
who inspires people like that too!
Because "admiration" must surely—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Because it has the power
to make anyone the very strongest! ♡
choice_data_list: Then we gotta take even more celeb-style photos!
Then we have to take even more celeb-style photos!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Because it has the power
to make anyone the very strongest! ♡
choice_data_list: Then we gotta take even more celeb-style photos!
Then we have to take even more celeb-style photos!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, leave it to me.
In fact, the true charm of this observation deck
only begins from here on out—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa, amazing!
Super prettyyy!! Super emo~~!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Fufu, this will surely be an unforgettable picture.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'll teach you the secret to taking pics with night views, too♪
Oh, since it's the last one, you hop in too, Trainer♡
And so, that final shot captured the most Umanes of the day.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
In that case, how about focusing on the hashtags?♪
For example—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Like '#Friends #With #AfterSchoolDate
#ChanChanAlliance #With
#CuteVivlosChan'!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll go with—
'#Together #Next #Time #Too...
#PinkyPromise #RememberCurren'

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Looks like the three of us are chatting away! ♡ In that case—
'#WhereNext #ChanChangVib-chan
#CelebSpot #TakingSuggestions' and post♪

And so, their cheerful voices echoed
as they played tag together for a while.
